studio-blue.name: Blue Studio Corporate
studio-blue.summary_zh: 蓝色纹理影棚：沉稳商务、柔和立体光、自然微笑
studio-blue.direction: A polished corporate studio portrait against a deep to medium blue or blue-gray backdrop with subtle, softly blurred mottled texture and gentle tonal variation. Use soft, slightly directional light for natural facial depth, realistic skin tones and clear eyes. Frame from the head through the upper chest with comfortable space around the head; show a little shoulder angle where consistent with the reference. Choose understated dark navy or charcoal business attire over a simple light top, or the user's preferred clothing. Keep the expression relaxed and approachable, with a subtle closed-mouth smile only if it remains recognizable.

studio-neutral.name: Neutral Minimal Studio
studio-neutral.summary_zh: 中性极简影棚：浅灰或米白背景、柔和定向光、简约服装
studio-neutral.direction: A minimalist professional studio portrait against a softly graded warm gray or off-white background with a little negative space. Use soft directional light, gentle facial depth, natural skin tones and clear eyes. Frame from the head through the upper chest, with an optional wider upper-body composition or slightly off-center placement if requested and compatible with the intended crop. Choose a simple knit top, shirt, or understated blazer according to the user's preference. Keep a relaxed natural expression, without changing identity or age.
